title: Piazzi's moving light

src.cite: New Lands; Monthly Weather Review, 1887

src.cite: New Lands, citing Comptes Rendus 85-538

src.cite: New Lands, citing Scientific American, May 7, 1892

src.cite: New Lands, citing Quar. Jour. Roy. Inst., 5-117

src.cite: Wikipedia, Great Disappointment

title: Black particles over Comrie

src.cite: New Lands, citing David Milne, Edin. New Phil. Jour.

src.cite: New Lands, citing London Standard, Nov. 7, 1889

title: Gilles de Rais is executed
text: Gilles de Rais, who took part in the same campaigns as Joan of Arc in 1429, is executed after being tried on charges of heresy, sodomy and the murder of numerous children. Since the early 19th century he has often been associated with the Bluebeard tale.

src.cite: Wikipedia, Gilles de Rais

title: Eddie's comet that moved 100 degrees

src.cite: New Lands, citing Edinburgh Annual Register, 1812-II-124

title: Anton LaVey dies

src.cite: Wikipedia, Church of Satan

title: Another concussion over Hereford
text: A concussion occurs in about the same region as that of Oct. 6, 1863. It is widely attributed to a great explosion, perhaps in London, and then supposed an earthquake when no terrestrial explosion could be found.

src.cite: New Lands

title: Houdini dies on Halloween

src.cite: Wikipedia, Harry Houdini

title: A giant slow object near Adrianople

src.work: The Book of the Damned (1919), Charles Fort

title: A bright white cloud over Hamar

src.cite: New Lands, citing Sidereal Messenger, 3-121

src.cite: New Lands, citing Rept. B. A., 1852-30
